_doc: Release gate for the analytics-agentic-speed planner + analyst prompts (one label = the pair). HARD rules block the release; SOFT rules warn. 'min' is a floor, 'max' a ceiling. Every bound sits below (or above) the measured production baseline so run-to-run noise does not fail a good prompt; each one is explained in cicd/README.md. The gate also adds two hard rules of its own: every dataset item evaluated, and every item read back from Langfuse with an answer_correct score. A MISSING metric fails.

config._doc: The standard Experiment A wide config the thresholds were calibrated at. scripts/prompt_gate.py runs exactly this; tests/test_prompt_gate.py keeps it equal to scripts/run_experiment.py (BREADTH['wide'], EXPERIMENT_A_ROUNDS).

baseline._doc: production v1 (planner v1, analyst v1), claude-opus-5-5, 15 questions, 300 scenarios/round, 2 rounds: Langfuse run breadth-300-20261126T232112Z.
